source.changes: Adapted the twelve stat blocks of issue #163 (Gnoll Warrior, Goat, Goblin Boss, Goblin Minion, Goblin Warrior, Gold Dragon Wyrmling, Gorgon, Gray Ooze, Green Dragon Wyrmling, Green Hag, Grick and Griffon; PDF pages 289–295 and 355) into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys. Trait, action, bonus action and reaction entries keep their source rules text, rejoined across line, column and page breaks; descriptive prose outside the stat blocks is omitted. A hit printed without dice keeps explicit zero dice. The Gray Ooze prints Initiative score 13 for modifier −2; the record keeps the score 8 that the modifier gives. No playable NPC behavior is granted.

actions.name: Weakening Breath
actions.text: Weakening Breath. Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature that isn’t currently affected by this breath in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 2 (1d4) from its damage rolls. traits.name: Amorphous
traits.text: Amorphous. The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.text: Corrosive Form. Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the ooze and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative −1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the ooze and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the weapon. The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal or wood in 1 round.

actions.text: Pseudopod. Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.text: Coven Magic. While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.text: Mimicry. The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
